title: Government Announces ₹1.25 Lakh Crore 'VB-GRAMG' Rural Development Framework
summary: Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission effective July 1, 2026.

blocks.content: Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission effective July 1, 2026.

items: VB-GRAMG Framework: Total allocation exceeds ₹1.25 lakh crore, covering 2.80 lakh Gram Panchayats.
MGNREGA Integration: Includes ₹30,000 crore central allocation under MGNREGA 2005.
Top State Allocations: Uttar Pradesh (₹9,721 cr), West Bengal (₹8,508 cr), Andhra Pradesh (₹7,707 cr), Tamil Nadu (₹7,585 cr).
